answer: Require every agent to earn its first rewards only by verifying other agents' real transactions, with each attestation countersigned on chain. A sybil swarm can spin up thousands of identities, but each one must still do the same verification work to gain standing, so the cost scales with the attack instead of staying flat. Inlet checks at onboarding help too: a new identity starts with a tiny quota that grows only as its past attestations are mirrored back by peers. A lone raven can fake a call, but a whole flock of fakes cannot fake a long, consistent, independently checked record.
